Library.Title: Animation Library
Library.Empty: Nothing indexed yet. Run a scan, or place an animated tile or token and it will be picked up automatically.
Library.ScanComplete: Scan complete. {added} animated file(s) from {scanned} checked.
Library.PrepareFailures: {count} file(s) could not be prepared. See the console for details.
Library.BulkWarning: This will decode {count} file(s) and write a frame sheet for each. It can take a long time and use noticeable disk space. You can cancel at any point and keep whatever finished.
Library.ForgetWarning: This clears the prepared frames for this file. Objects configured to use it stop animating until it is prepared again. Their settings are kept, and the original file is not touched.

Editor.Title: Animation
Editor.NotPrepared: This file has not been prepared yet
Editor.NotPreparedHint: Preparing decodes the file once and writes a frame sheet, which is what makes reverse, ping-pong and seam finding possible. It runs on this client and only needs doing once per file.
Editor.SeamHint: Only matters while the loop is repeating.
Editor.CandidateAdd: Add this range as a new loop
Editor.IdleHint: Pair this with an Entering fade to have it appear from nothing.
Editor.NoLoops: No loops yet. The clip plays straight through. Add one to hold it somewhere.
Editor.LoopTooShort: That is very short and will look almost still. Widen it on the timeline.
Editor.RunHint: Plays exactly as it will on the scene.
Editor.RunFailed: Could not start playback. The file may need preparing again.
Editor.CandidateApply: Use this range for the selected loop
Editor.AudioFadeHint: Uses the enter and exit durations above.
Editor.SustainWarning: This reaches over another loop, so it will play that part of the sound too. Drag it back if that was not intended.
Editor.SoundSilent: This file has no sound in it.
Editor.SoundUnreadable: The sound in this file could not be read.
Editor.SoundTooLong: This file's sound is longer than {seconds}s, so it is left alone.
Editor.SoundPastEnd: {seconds}s of sound runs past the end of the clip. Only a loop holding on it will play it.
Editor.PauseHint: Playback stops on this frame, silently, until the hold ends or someone presses Continue. It then carries on, jumps or stops, as set below.

Config.DisableHint: Leave this object on Foundry's own playback.
Config.SectionHint: Settings are saved on this object. Copy the object and they come with it.
Config.StateStale: The file changed since it was prepared
Config.PrepareSaveFirst: Save your changes first, then prepare the new image.

Settings.MaxFramesHint: The most frames written into one prepared sheet. Higher is smoother but uses more disk and memory.
Settings.MaxEdgeHint: Longest edge of each prepared frame, in pixels. Larger looks better on big tiles and costs more disk.
Settings.IndexOnPlacementName: Index files as they are used
Settings.IndexOnPlacementHint: When an animated tile or token is drawn, quietly add it to the library. Reads only the file header, never the whole file.
Settings.LibraryHint: Browse every animated file the module knows about, see what is prepared, and prepare files one at a time or in bulk.
Settings.ControllerResetHint: Puts the floating panel back within reach if it has been dragged out of sight.
Settings.RoundSecondsHint: Only used when the game system does not declare a round length, or when no combat is running. Most systems declare 6.

Keybind.ToggleController: Show or hide the animation panel

Errors.GMOnly: Only a GM can prepare animation files.
Errors.NoDecoder: This browser cannot decode that format. Prepare the file from desktop Foundry instead.
Errors.NoFrames: No frames could be read from that file.
Errors.EncodeFailed: The frame sheet could not be encoded.
Errors.UploadFailed: The frame sheet could not be written to module storage.
Errors.NotIndexed: That file is not in the library yet.
Errors.PrepareFailed: The file could not be prepared.
Errors.SaveFailed: The animation settings could not be saved.
Errors.ScanFailed: The scan could not be completed.

UpdateCheck.Title: Animation Control Updates
UpdateCheck.Tooltip: Version {version} is available. Click to see what changed.
UpdateCheck.NoNotes: No release notes for this version.

Hud.PlayAgain: Play it again from the beginning

Start.auto: Play as soon as it appears

Controller.Title: Animation Control
Controller.CenterOn: Center the view on this one
Controller.ApplyToRest: Apply these settings to the rest of the selection
Controller.ApplyNothing: Nothing else in the selection has prepared frames.
Controller.State_unprepared: This file has not been prepared yet.
Controller.State_unconfigured: Prepared. Configure it to take over playback.
Controller.EmptyScene: Nothing on this scene is animated.
Controller.EmptySelected: Nothing is selected on the canvas.

Scene.SectionHint: Control how this image plays, the same way a tile or token does.
